title: 7 Ways a Godly Man Is Harder on Himself Than He Is on Anyone Else
caption:
Most men have it backward.

He catches his own excuse before he catches yours. Apologizes first, even the half that isn't his fault. Holds his own word to a higher standard than anyone else's. Forgives your failure faster than he forgives his own.

Why do you look at the speck in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own? (Matthew 7:3)

Hard on himself, gentle with everyone else. That's the order most men never flip.

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
